d: Shimla ke Marleville Mansion ki sabse khaufnak kahani. Jab Anika Sen ne saste daam par is badi property ko ek investment samajh kar khareeda, to usne caretaker Keshav ki chetavani ko nazarandaz kar diya—jisme usne upar ke corridor ke aakhiri band kamre se door rehne ko kaha tha. Lekin jald hi aisi ajeeb aur daraavani ghatnayein shuru ho gayi: Anika ka samaan achanak gayab hona, darwaze ke peeche se dheemi aawazein aana, aur deewaron se lekar CCTV footage tak mein ulti chalti bhootia parchhai ka dikhna. Dekhiye is purane British mansion ka wo kaala sach jisne Anika ki poori zindagi badal…
